newsitem.title: USA: Midcoast acquires Kansas gas interests.
newsitem.headline: Midcoast acquires Kansas gas interests.

text.p: Midcoast Energy Resources, Inc said Thursday it has acquired controlling interests in a natural gas gathering system in south-central Kansas from MAPCO Natural Gas Liquids, Inc.
Under the terms of the transaction, valued at $250,000, Midcoast acquires the Raymond System in exchange for the Cat Springs and Stratton Ridge systems.
The Raymond system, a 120-mile pipeline in McPherson, Rice, Barton and Stafford Counties, Kansas, gathers gas from 16 producers across 25 leases.
Though the Raymond system has been inactive since December 1995, it will brought back into service by Midcoast "immediately," the company said in a statement.
The Cat Springs and Stratton Ridge systems comprise a total 2.3 miles of pipeline and supply pumping stations owned by MAPCO's unit Seminole Pipeline Co.
